about: The catena of prophecy goes on in the frame 'and as so-and-so prophesied and said': David, Isaiah, Solomon (Wisdom speaking before the world's making), Job, Micah, David and Moses are each cited as foretelling that God would come, that the nations would trust in his name, and that Israel's one God is a Trinity. The chapter closes with a doxology and the edition's closing ornament.

sentences.i: And as the prophet David prophesied, speaking about the Christian people: 'Say to the nations that God has become king and has made the world firm, so that it will not be shaken.'
sentences.n: The catena of prophecy opens in the frame already met, ወበከመ ተነበየ X 'and-as prophesied X' (ወ- 'and', በ- + ከመ 'as'; perfect ተነበየ with the prophet after the verb); I only nudge it from here on. እንዘ ይብል 'while he says' is the standing way to introduce what a prophet said. ሕዝበ ክርስቲያን is a construct chain 'people-of Christian', i.e. the Christian people. በልዎሙ is the imperative 'say to them!' (በል- + ሎሙ), and ለአሕዛብ 'to the nations' names them again (ለ- + plural). The quoted words are Psalm 96:10 (numbered 95:10 in the Septuagint and Ethiopic Psalters): God has reigned and made the world firm. Crux: ወአጽንዓ ለዓለም. አጽንዓ is the ʾa-stem 'he made firm' plus the suffix -ኣ 'her', and ለዓለም then repeats the object ('made it firm, the world'); ለዓለም could instead be 'for ever', but the Psalm's sense favours 'the world' (?). ከመ ኢታንቀልቅል is 'that not it be shaken': the 3fs imperfect (ታ-, agreeing with the feminine ዓለም) of the four-radical ንቀልቀለ 'shake' (?); whether the sense is passive or intransitive ('that it not shake') is uncertain (?).

sentences.i: And again he prophesied about his coming to the nations, and said: 'From before the face of God, for he comes, he comes, and he will judge the earth and judge the world in righteousness, and the nations also in uprightness.' And as the prophet Isaiah prophesied and said: 'The God of hosts has taken counsel to overthrow the arrogance of the nations, and to bring low the honoured, the great ones of the earth.'
sentences.n: The first quotation closely matches Psalm 96:13 and Psalm 98:9 (95:13 and 97:9 in the Septuagint numbering); the text names David only in the frame, and I take the Psalm as the source (?). ወካዕበ 'and again'; ምጽአቱ 'his coming' (noun + -ሁ); ኀበ አሕዛብ 'to nations'. The Geʿez says ገጹ ለእግዚአብሔር, literally 'his face, of God': the suffix anticipates the owner, named with ለ-. ይመጽእ ይመጽእ 'he comes, he comes' is repeated for emphasis. ወይኴንና 'and he judges her': ይኴንን (root ኰነነ, 'judge, rule') + -ኣ 'her', with ለምድር and ለዓለም repeating the object; ወለአሕዛብኒ 'and the nations also' (-ኒ 'also') has no verb of its own, so 'he judges' carries over. በጽድቅ and በርትዕ: በ- 'in'. Isaiah's words: ጸባኦት is the loan 'hosts' (Sabaoth), standing after እግዚኣብሔር, so 'God of hosts' (the house rendering of እግዚኣብሔር is 'God'). I cannot place the passage with certainty; it resembles Isaiah 23:9 (?). መከረ ይስዐር 'he took counsel (that) he overthrow' puts a perfect and a jussive side by side without a conjunction. Uncertain lexical calls (?): ይስዐር I take as 'overthrow, bring down' (the same root also means 'forgive'); ጽዕለቶሙ as 'their arrogance' (could be 'hostility'). ወያኅስሮሙ is the ʾa-stem 'and he diminishes them, brings them low' (?). ለክቡራን ዐበይተ ምድር: 'the honoured ones', with 'great ones of the earth' in apposition (ዐበይተ is a construct, ምድር follows it).

sentences.i: And he went on with his prophecy and said: 'He will come, and build his house, and save his people.'
sentences.n: ወዓዲ 'and still, further'. አትለወ is the ʾa-stem 'he continued, followed on' (?), so 'he went on with his prophecy'; the subject is still Isaiah, the prophet just named. ትንቢቶ 'his prophecy' (ትንቢት + -ኦ, accusative). The three verbs ይመጽእ 'he comes', ወየሐንጽ 'and he builds' and ወያድኅን 'and he saves' are all 3ms imperfect (the last an ʾa-stem, 'cause to be safe'), with ቤቶ 'his house' and ሕዝቦ 'his people' as objects. The text gives no further source and I name none.

sentences.i: And he added further and said: 'On that day one will spring from the root of Jesse, who was appointed messenger of the nations; and the nations will put their trust in him, and the glory of his resting place will be for ever (?).' And as David prophesied and said: 'Sing to God who dwells in Zion, and tell the nations his deeds.' And as his son Solomon prophesied and said of our Saviour Emmanuel, the sun of righteousness: 'Before the hills he begot me; and before he [unclear verb] and made (it) in the places (?); and before the world he founded me;
sentences.n: Three citations in one unit; 50 words and no ፤ inside it, so it stays whole to the closing ፤. ወዓዲ ወሰከ ወይቤ: ወሰከ 'he added' (so 'he further added and said'). The first quotation is Isaiah 11:10 (the text does not name Isaiah here; the frame ወውእተ አሚረ 'and on that day' is the clue): ይሠርጽ 'he sprouts, springs forth'; እምሥርወ እሴይ 'from the root-of Jesse' (construct); ዘተሠይመ 'who was appointed', a passive (tä-stem) with the predicate መልአከ 'messenger-of' (construct, with አሕዛብ). መልአክ usually 'angel, messenger', so 'messenger' (?); another sense, such as 'ruler', is possible (?). ወይትዌከሉ ቦቱ 'and they trust in him' (ተወከለ). ወይከውን ክብረ ምዕራፊሁ: I take ክብረ as a construct, 'glory-of his resting place', as the thing that will be for ever (?); the other reading, ክብረ as an accusative predicate ('his resting place will be glory'), is possible (?). The ending of ምዕራፊሁ is unusual for a singular noun, so it may be plural, 'his resting places' (?). The David citation is Psalm 9:11 (9:12 in the Septuagint): ዘምሩ 'sing!' (2mp imperative), ዘየኀድር 'who dwells', ወንግርዎሙ ለአሕዛብ 'and tell them, the nations' (the suffix is repeated by the noun), ምግባሮ 'his deeds'. ወልዲ is Bezold's spelling of 'his son'. Solomon's words are Proverbs 8:22-31, Wisdom speaking, which the text reads as Christ speaking; 'sun of righteousness' (ፀሐየ ጽድቅ, construct) is the title of Malachi 4:2, here applied to Emmanuel (አማኑኤል, 'God with us'). I begin the quotation at እምቅድመ. Proverbs 8:25: እምቅድመ አውግር ወለደኒ 'before the hills he begot me' (ወለደ + -ኒ 'me'). The next clause is a crux: ይጠአጣእ is a verb I cannot identify (?), probably a rare quadriliteral; ወይግበር በሓውርተ 'and he makes in the places' (?) — ሓውርት is 'place' in the Micah citation below. The English leaves the verb as [unclear verb] rather than guess one. ሣረረኒ 'he founded me' is ሠረረ spelled with ሣ (a Bezold spelling); the sentence has no closing mark of its own and runs into the next unit.

sentences.n: The speech of Wisdom (Proverbs 8) continues from the unit before. ዘእንበለ 'without, before' with a jussive (ዘእንበለ ምድረ ይግበር 'before he make the earth'); I use the English past. ቀላ ፡ ያተ is printed with a wordspace inside the word; it is ቀላያት 'deeps, seas' (plural of ቀላይ), kept as printed. The three later 'before' clauses have their subjects in the accusative -ተ (አንቅዕተ ማያት 'springs-of waters', ሥነ ጽገያት 'beauty-of flowers', ነፋሳተ አየር 'winds-of air') though they belong to ይፃእ 'go out', ወያስተርኢ 'and appear' and ይንፋሕ 'blow'; the accusative simply looks careless (?). ጽገያት is the plural of ጽጌ 'flower'. ፈጠራ ለምግባሩ 'he created her for his work': the suffix -ኣ is feminine ('her'), though the speaker says 'I' straight after; Wisdom is feminine and the shift of person is the text's own. ኣስተዋድድ is a 1cs imperfect (the ኣ- is this edition's spelling of the 1cs prefix) of a stem built on ወድደ 'love'; 'I was delighting' is my best reading (?). The quotation continues into the next unit; I close it here at ። for the English.

sentences.i: And as his father David prophesied and said: 'Before the sun his name was, and before the moon, for generation upon generation.' And as his son Solomon prophesied and said: 'When he makes firm the upper parts of the clouds (?), and when he sets the seat of the edges (?) of the ends of the heavens, and when he sets the sea within its bound, and before he founds his throne above the winds, and when he makes firm the foundations of the earth, I was with him, delighting. I am the one in whom he always rejoices, she of the morning (?), and I rejoice with him at all times before his face.' And as the prophet Job prophesied and said: 'He who is the face of my God is the east, and his light is before the sun, and the nations will put their trust in his name.'
sentences.n: Three citations in 74 words, no ፤ inside, so the unit stays whole, ending at ።. David: Psalm 72:17 (71:17 in the Septuagint) is the probable source (?): ህሎ ስሙ 'his name was' (ህሎ is a spelling of ሀሎ); ወርኅ 'moon' (a plain noun); ለትውልደ ትውልድ 'for generation-of generation', i.e. 'for all generations', governs the whole line. አቡሁ ዳዊት 'his father David' marks David as Solomon's father. Solomon: Proverbs 8:27-31, Wisdom's speech, again. The verbs are 3ms imperfect with አመ 'when' (አመ ይገብር 'when he makes'); ጽኑዐ is an accusative adjective ('firm'), and I read 'when he makes firm the upper parts of the clouds' (?). Several words are uncertain: ምንባረ አረፋተ አጽናፈ ሰማያት, rendered 'seat of the edges of the ends of the heavens' (ምንባር 'seat, place', from ነበረ 'sit, set'; አረፋተ 'edges' is my guess) (?); ያነብራ ለባሕር በዐቅማ 'he sets her, the sea, in her bound' (ዐቅም as 'limit, bound' is uncertain) (?); and እንተ ጸብሐት, which I take as 'she of the morning', i.e. 'bright as morning' (?); the clause አነ ውእቱ ለእንተ ይትፌሥሕ ወትረ is itself awkward (ውእቱ is masculine, እንተ feminine), and I read 'I am the one in whom he always rejoices' (?). ሀሎኩ 'I was'; ወእትሐሠይ 'and I rejoice' (tä-stem, 1cs). መንበሮ 'his throne'; መሠረታተ ምድር 'foundations-of earth' (a construct). ይሣርር 'he founds' (ሠረረ, as above). Job: I cannot identify the passage; the attribution to Job, called 'prophet', is the text's own, and the last clause echoes the 'nations trust in his name' of Isaiah 42:4 (?). ዘውእቱ ገጸ አምላኪየ ምሥራቅ: ገጸ is construct before አምላኪየ 'my God'; I read 'he who is the face of my God is the east' (?).

sentences.i: And as the prophet Isaiah prophesied and said: 'Do not remember the former things (?), and do not ponder what was before. Behold, I am making a new thing, which is now springing up; and that you may know, I make a way in the desert and pour out water in the wilderness, and the beasts of the wilderness will come after me, and the young of birds, and the sirens;
sentences.n: Isaiah 43:18-20. ኢትዝከሩ and ወኢተኀልዩ are 2mp negative imperatives ('do not remember', 'do not ponder'); ዘትካት is uncertain (?): I take it as 'the former things' by parallel with ዘቀዲሙ 'what was before' (ዘ- 'that which' + ቀዲሙ). ናሁ አነ እገብር ሐዲሰ 'behold, I make a new thing' (ሐዲሰ accusative). ዘይእዜ ይሠርቅ 'which now rises, springs up'. ወከመ ታእምሩ 'and that you may know' (2mp subjunctive). በድው and ገዳም are both 'desert, wilderness'; ወኣውሕዝ 'and I pour out' (1cs of አውሐዘ; the ኣ- is the edition's 1cs prefix). ወይድኅሩኒ is 3mp of the root ደኀረ 'be behind' plus -ኒ 'me': 'they will come after me, follow me' (?), as the form is written. እጓለ አዕዋፍ 'young-of birds' (construct). ወሴሬኔሲ is the Greek loan 'sirens' (Septuagint Isaiah), kept as 'sirens'. The unit closes at ፤; the sentence goes on.

sentences.i: For I gave water in the desert and poured it out in the wilderness, so that I might give drink to my people and to my chosen ones, whom I have selected (?), that they may tell my glory and do my commandment.' And as Solomon prophesied and said: 'Who went up to heaven and came down? Who gathered the winds into his bosom? Who bound up the waters in his garment? Who measured the water of the sea in the hollow of his hand, and the heaven also with his span? Who is his name, and who is the name of his son?'
sentences.n: Isaiah 43:20-21 finishes, still inside the previous quotation. እስመ 'for'; ወሀብኩ 'I gave' (1cs perfect); ከመ ኣስትዮሙ 'that I give them to drink' (ʾa-stem, 1cs subjunctive, with -ሙ 'them'); እለ አጥረይኩ 'whom I selected' (the verb is uncertain, 'selected / acquired' (?)); ወለኅሩያንየ 'and for my chosen ones' (ኅሩይ 'chosen' + -የ); ስብሐትየ 'my glory'; ትእዛዝየ 'my commandment'. Solomon: Proverbs 30:4, in the form of questions: መኑ 'who?' repeated. ዐርገ 'went up', ወወረደ 'and came down'; ሕፅኑ 'his bosom' (or the hollow of the hands) (?); ዘዐቈረ 'who bound' (ዘ- after መኑ is just 'who'); ሰፈረ 'measured'; ሕፍኑ 'his palm, hollow of his hand'; በስዝሩ 'with his span'; ወሰማየኒ 'and heaven also' (-ኒ). The phrase 'measured the water of the sea in the hollow of the hand and the heaven with the span' is also Isaiah 40:12 in its content, so the text may blend the two (?). ወመኑ ስሙ ወመኑ ስመ ወልዲ: 'and who his name, and who the name of his son' (ወልዲ again Bezold's 'his son'; ስመ is accusative). The unit is 49 words and has no ፤ inside; kept whole.

sentences.n: Source slip or the text's own error: the first quotation is Malachi 1:10-11 in its content, but the text attributes it to Micah (ሚኪያስ), and I keep that as printed. ወይቤሎሙ ለአይሁድ 'and he said to them, to the Jews' (ለ- repeats the object). ኢይሠምር ብክሙ 'he is not pleased with you': negative 3ms imperfect of ሠምረ 'be pleased', ብክሙ 'in you' (በ- + -ክሙ). ዘኵሎ ይመልክ 'who rules all' (a standing epithet of God). ምሥዋዕተክሙ is 'your altar-offerings' (?), perhaps 'your altars'; ወኢይትመጠው ቊርባነ 'and he does not receive an offering' (tä-stem of መጠወ, 'receive'); እምእዴክሙ 'from your hands'. ዐረብ in እምሥራቀ ፀሐይ እስከ ዐረብ is 'west, sunset' (ዐረበ 'it set'), though the same spelling is 'Arabs/Arabia' in other places; ምሥራቀ ፀሐይ is a construct, 'east-of sun', i.e. the sunrise. ይሴባሕ 'is praised' (passive); በሓውርት 'place' (?) with ወበኵሉ 'and in every'; ይትቄረብ 'is offered, brought near' (tä-stem); ዕጣን 'incense'; ስምየ 'my name', with ዐቢይ 'great' after the noun. The second quotation is Micah 4:1-2, and the text now names Micah correctly (ወካዕበ ይቤ ሚኪያስ ነቢይ). ሐዲስ ሥርዐት 'a new ordinance' (?) stands in apposition to ደብረ እግዚኣብሔር 'mount-of God' (construct). ወድልውት 'and prepared' is a feminine form (?) though ደብር is normally masculine. ወይትሌዐል 'and it will be exalted' (tä-stem, 3ms). ንዑ ንዕርግ 'come, let us go up' (imperative + 1cp jussive). 62 words, no ፤ inside, so the unit stays whole to its closing ፤.

sentences.i: And many nations will go to him, and say, "Come, let us go up to the mount of God, that they may tell us his way, and let us walk in it."' And as the prophet David prophesied and said: 'Hear me, my people, and I will speak to you; Israel, I will let you hear (?): I am God, your God.' And as the prophet Moses prophesied and said, about the Trinity: 'Hear, Israel: one is God, your God';
sentences.n: The Micah quotation (4:2) ends here. ወየሐውሩ 'and they go' (3mp of ሖረ); ኀቤሁ 'to him'; ብዙኃን አሕዛብ 'many nations' (adjective first). ወይንግሩነ 'that they tell us' is plural ('they'), where one might expect 'he tells us'; the plural is as printed and its subject is unclear (?). ወንሖር 'and let us walk' (1cp jussive); ባቲ 'in her' (ፍኖት, 'way', is feminine). The David quotation is Psalm 81:8-10 (80:9-11 in the Septuagint): ስምዐኒ 'hear me!' (imperative + -ኒ); ወእንግርከ 'and I tell you'; እስራኤል is the vocative; ኣሰምዕ ለከ is a 1cs ʾa-stem, 'I make you hear, I let you hear' (?), the causative of ሰምዐ; 'testify' would need another word; አምላክከሰ አምላክ አነ ውእቱ 'as for your God, God am I' (-ሰ marks the contrast). Moses: ስማዕ እስራኤል ፩ ውእቱ እግዚኣብሔር አምላክከ is Deuteronomy 6:4 (the Shema); the text frames it as being about the Trinity, ሥላሴ (ሥላሴ is the abstract 'threeness'). ፩ is 'one' (spoken አሐዱ). The Micah quotation, opened in the unit before, closes after ፍኖቶ ወንሖር ባቲ; the Moses quotation closes at አምላክከ, and the Trinitarian comment of the author follows.

sentences.n: The author's own comment on Deuteronomy 6:4. ወዘንተሰ: ወ- + ዘንተ (accusative 'this') + -ሰ ('indeed, as for'). ይትፌከር is a tä-stem imperfect of ፈከረ 'explain, interpret': 'it is explained' (?); the following list reads as what 'this' is to be explained as. Source slips kept as printed: ፩ውእቱ has no wordspace after ፩ ('one', i.e. ፩ ፡ ውእቱ 'one is'); ስልጣኖ ፡ ሙ is ስልጣኖሙ 'their authority' (ስልጣን + -ሙ) split by a wordspace; and ይሰግዲ ends in -ዲ where -ዱ ('they bow', 3mp of ሰገደ) is expected, as in ወልዲ elsewhere. ዘአሐቲ መንግሥቶሙ ወአሐቲ ስልጣኖሙ: ዘ- 'whose' with the nominal clause 'one (is) their kingdom, and one their authority' (አሐቲ is the feminine form, as with the feminine መንግሥት). ወአሐተ ይሰግዲ ሎሙ: 'and one-wise they bow to them' (ወአሐተ an adverbial accusative); the sense is that all creation worships the three as one, but ወአሐተ is uncertain (?), perhaps 'one-wise, together'. ሎሙ 'to them'. The four places, በሰማይ ወበምድር በባሕር ወበቀላያት, are all በ- 'in, on'; ወበቀላያት 'and in the deeps' (as above).

sentences.i: And to him be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
sentences.n: The closing doxology of chapter 106. ወሎቱ 'and to him' (ወ- + ለ- + -ቱ, 'him'); ስብሐት 'glory, praise'; ለዓለመ ዓለም 'for age-of age', the usual 'for ever and ever' (ዓለመ is the construct). The ten ፨ marks that close the unit are the edition's own ending ornament, kept in t and left untranslated.

glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?) · 'of' before a genitive, standing for the feminine relative (ሃይማኖት እንተ አበው ሐዋርያት 'the faith of the fathers, the apostles'; ሃይማኖተ እንተ ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'the faith of the Church') · fem. relative before a verb with the object understood (ሥጋ እንተ ነሥአ 'the flesh which he took') · 'in which, through which' before በ- + suffix (እንተ ባቲ 'which in her') · 'the one' in እንተ የማኑ 'that of his right', and before a verb with suffix, 'which founded it' (እንተ ሣረረታ)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እገብር: ገብረ — I do, make (1cs imperfect, G)
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her') · 'like one who' before ዘ- + preposition (ከመ ዘቦቱ 'like one who has')
glossary.ክብረ: ክብር — glory, honour (construct 'glory of') · accusative 'glory' (ወሀቦሙ ክብረ 'he gave them glory')
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this' · ኵሉ ዘ- 'all who' (ኵሉ ዘሞአ 'all who conquered')
glossary.ወሀብኩ: ወሀበ — I gave (1cs perfect, G, w-h-b; the first ወ is a root letter)
glossary.ወህሎኩ: ሀለወ — and I was (ወ- + 1cs perfect, spelling variant ህሎኩ of ሀሎኩ)
glossary.ወለኅሩያንየ: ኅሩይ — and to my chosen ones (ወ- + ለ- + plural ኅሩያን + -የ '1cs my')
glossary.ወለአሕዛብኒ: ሕዝብ — and the nations also (ወ- + ለ- marking the object, the verb ወይኴንና carried over + plural አሕዛብ + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወለደኒ: ወለደ — he begot me (3ms perfect, G, w-l-d, + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ወልዲ: ወልድ — my son (noun + 1cs suffix -ī, written -ዲ; variant of ወልድየ) (?) · his son (noun + -ዲ for 3ms -ሁ 'his', Bezold's spelling; ለሰሎሞን ወልዲ 'to Solomon, his son'; ለአድራሚ ወልዲ 'Adrami, his son')
glossary.ወርኅ: ወርኅ — moon, month (noun; construct 'of the moon')
glossary.ወሰማየኒ: ሰማይ — and heaven also (ወ- + noun, accusative ሰማየ + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወሰከ: ወሰከ — he added (3ms perfect, G, w-s-k; the ወ is a root letter, not 'and')
glossary.ወሴሬኔሲ: ሴሬኔስ — and sirens (?) (ወ- + Greek loanword σειρῆνες 'sirens', plural in -ሲ) (?)
glossary.ወበምድር: ምድር — and on earth (ወ- + በ- + noun)
glossary.ወበቀላያት: ቀላይ — and in the deeps (ወ- + በ- + noun, plural ቀላያት)
glossary.ወበከመ: ከመ — and as, and according as (ወ- 'and' + በ- + ከመ)
glossary.ወበኵሉ: ኵሉ — and in all, in every (ወ- + በ- + quantifier)
glossary.ወትረ: ወትር — always, continually (adverb, accusative; ወ- is part of the word)
glossary.ወንሖር: ሖረ — and let us go (ወ- 'and' + 1cp jussive, G, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.ወንግርዎሙ: ነገረ — and tell! (ወ- + G 2mp imperative with suffix 3mp -ሙ, 'tell them')
glossary.ወአሐተ: አሐቲ — and one (ወ- + numeral, fem., accusative አሐተ) · adverbial 'and as one' (?) before ይሰግዲ 'they bow' (ወአሐተ ይሰግዲ ሎሙ 'and they bow to them as one') (?)
glossary.ወአሐቲ: አሐዱ — and one (ወ- + numeral, fem. አሐቲ)
glossary.ወአመ: አመ — and when, on the day that (ወ- + conjunction/preposition)
glossary.ወአውሐዝኩ: አውሐዘ — and I poured out (ወ- + 1cs perfect, ʾa-stem, w-ḥ-z)
glossary.ወአጽንዓ: አጽንዐ — and he made firm, established (ወ- + 3ms perfect, ʾa-stem, ṣ-n-ʿ, + -ኣ 'her')
glossary.ወኢተኀልዩ: ኀለየ — and do not ponder, consider (ወ- + ኢ- + 2mp jussive, G, ḫ-l-y)
glossary.ወኢይሠምር: ሠምረ — and he is not pleased (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, G, ś-m-r)
glossary.ወኢይትመጠው: ተመጠወ — and he does not receive, accept (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem, m-ṭ-w)
glossary.ወኣውሕዝ: አውሐዘ — and I pour out (ወ- + 1cs imperfect, ʾa-stem, w-ḥ-z; ኣ = ʾa)
glossary.ወእትሐሠይ: ተሐሠየ — and that I rejoice (ወ- + 1cs jussive, tä-stem) · 'and I rejoice' (1cs imperfect, indicative) after ይትፌሥሕ (ወእትሐሠይ ምስሌሁ 'and I rejoice with him')
glossary.ወእንግርከ: ነገረ — and I tell you (ወ- + 1cs imperfect, G, n-g-r, + -ከ '2ms you')
glossary.ወእጓለ: እጓል — and child of (ወ- 'and' + noun, construct; with ማውታ 'child of the dead', orphan)
glossary.ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this') · 'and like' before a noun (ወከመ ድምፀ አንበሳ 'and like the voice of a lion')
glossary.ወወልድ: ወልድ — and the Son · and 'a son' in general (ወወልድ ለአብ 'and a son to the father')
glossary.ወወረደ: ወረደ — and he/it descended (ወ- + 3m sg perfect, w-r-d)
glossary.ወውእተ: ውእቱ — and that (ወ- + demonstrative, accusative ውእተ, before አሚረ 'that day')
glossary.ወዓዲ: ዓዲ — and still, also, moreover (ወ- + adverb)
glossary.ወዘንተሰ: ዝንቱ — and this, indeed (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ + enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — and without (ወ- + preposition) · 'and before' + subjunctive (ወዘእንበለ ታጥብዎ 'and before she could nurse him')
glossary.ወየሐንጽ: ሐነጸ — and he builds (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, ḥ-n-ṣ)
glossary.ወየሐውሩ: ሖረ — and they go (ወ- 'and' + 3mp imperfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.ወያስተርኢ: አስተርአየ — and he appears (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, ʾastä-stem)
glossary.ወያኅስሮሙ: አኀሰረ — and he diminishes them (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, ʾa-stem, ḫ-s-r, + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወያድኅን: አድኀነ — and he saves (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, ʾa-stem)
glossary.ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወይብሉ: ብህለ — and they say (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, defective b-h-l)
glossary.ወይትሌዐል: ተለዐለ — and may he be exalted (ወ- + 3ms jussive, tä-stem, root l-ʿ-l 'be high') · and it will be exalted, with a thing as subject (ወይትሌዐል ክብርከ 'and your glory will be exalted')
glossary.ወይትዌከሉ: ተወከለ — and they will trust (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, tä-stem, w-k-l)
glossary.ወይንግሩነ: ነገረ — and that they tell us (ወ- + 3mp subjunctive, G, n-g-r, + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.ወይከውን: ኮነ — and it will be (ወ- + 3ms imperf., k-w-n)
glossary.ወይኴንና: ኰነነ — and he judges her (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, k-w-n-n, + -ኣ 'her', anticipating the following ለ- noun)
glossary.ወይድኅሩኒ: ደኀረ — and they follow me (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, d-ḫ-r, + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ወይግበሩ: ገብረ — and they shall make (ወ- + 3mp jussive/imperfect)
glossary.ወይግበር: ገብረ — and let him do (ወ- + 3ms jussive, G, g-b-r) · 'and (before) he make', in a 'before … and …' clause (ወይግበር በሓውርተ) (?)
glossary.ወድልውት: ድልው — and prepared, ready (ወ- + adjective, fem. ድልውት)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is') · 'that' (demonstrative before a noun: ውእቱ ቃለ እግዚኣብሔር 'that word of God')
glossary.ዐረብ: ዐረብ — Arabs, Arabia (noun; the dependent noun after the construct ብሔረ) · 'the west' (sunset), in እምሥራቀ ፀሐይ እስከ ዐረብ 'from the east of the sun to the west' (cf. ዐረበ 'it set') (?)
glossary.ዐርገ: ዐርገ — he went up (3ms perfect, ʿ-r-g)
glossary.ዐበይተ: ዐቢይ — great (adjective; plural ዐበይት, accusative form) · as a noun, 'great ones, notables' (construct, ዐበይተ እስራኤል 'notables of Israel')
glossary.ዕጣን: ዕጣን — incense (noun; here genitive after a construct) · incense as the subject of a passive verb (ዕጣን ይትቄረብ 'incense is offered')
glossary.ዘቀዲሙ: ቀዲሙ — what (was) before, formerly (ዘ- 'that which' + adverb ቀዲሙ 'before, formerly')
glossary.ዘተሠይመ: ሤመ — who was appointed (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, tä-stem passive, ś-y-m)
glossary.ዘትካት: ትካት — of establishment, the established (?) (ዘ- + noun; cf. ተከለ 'plant, establish') (?) · ከመ ዘትካት 'as before, as formerly' (idiom, of the face and gaze) (?) · ዘትካት ልማድ 'the former (or established) custom' (ዘ- + noun qualifying ልማድ; ch. 89) (?) · 'the former things' (?) before ዘቀዲሙ 'what was before' (ኢትዝከሩ ዘትካት 'do not remember the former things') (?)
glossary.ዘአሐቲ: አሐዱ — whose is one (ዘ- 'of, whose' + fem. numeral አሐቲ 'one'; nominal clause ዘአሐቲ መንግሥቶሙ)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?) · 'except' before a number (ዘእንበለ ፻ወ፳ ዓመት 'except for a hundred and twenty years') · 'except only' with ዳእሙ (ዘእንበለ ዳእሙ ዘያሠርጽ 'except only what he sows') · 'without' before a noun (ዘእንበለ ኀፍረት 'without shame')
glossary.ዘኵሎ: ኵሉ — who (over) all (ዘ- + ኵሉ accusative; ዘኵሎ ይመልክ 'who rules all') · 'all', in loose apposition after ዘገብራ (ዘገብራ ዘኵሎ 'that made it, all'; the construction is uncertain) (?)
glossary.ዘውእቱ: ውእቱ — who is, namely (ዘ- relative + 3ms pronoun)
glossary.ዘዐቈረ: ዐቈረ — who bound, tied up (?) (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G, ʿ-q-r) (?)
glossary.ዘየኀድር: ኀደረ — who dwells (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G, ḫ-d-r)
glossary.ዘይእዜ: ይእዜ — which is now (ዘ- relative + adverb ይእዜ 'now')
glossary.ያስተርኢ: አስተርአየ — he/it appears, is manifest (3ms imperfect, ʾastä-stem)
glossary.ያተ: ቀላይ — the deeps (noun; ያተ is the ending of ቀላያተ 'deeps', plural accusative, completing the preceding ቀላ)
glossary.ያነብራ: አነበረ — he sets her (3ms imperfect, ʾa-stem of ነበረ 'sit', n-b-r, + -ኣ 'her'; after አመ 'when')
glossary.ያነብር: አነበረ — that he set, place (3ms jussive, causative of ነበረ) · he places (3ms imperfect/jussive, each man places a sword)
glossary.ይመልክ: መልከ — he rules, reigns over (3ms imperfect, G, m-l-k)
glossary.ይመጽእ: መጽአ — he comes (3ms subjunctive, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ይሠርቅ: ሠረቀ — it sprouts, rises (3ms imperfect, G, ś-r-q)
glossary.ይሠርጽ: ሠረጸ — he sprouts, shoots forth (3ms imperfect, G, ś-r-ṣ)
glossary.ይሣርር: ሠረረ — that he found, lay a foundation (?) (3ms subjunctive, root ś-r-r; spelled with ሣ, irregular for a G imperfect, lemma a guess) (?)
glossary.ይሰግዲ: ሰገደ — they bow down (3mp imperfect, G, s-g-d, written with final -ዲ)
glossary.ይሴባሕ: ሰብሐ — that he be praised (3ms subjunctive, passive of ሰብሐ 'praise'; ከመ ይሴባሕ ቦሙ 'that he be praised through them') · 'is praised' (indicative), with a thing as subject (ይሴባሕ ስምየ 'my name is praised')
glossary.ይስዐር: ሰዐረ — that he overthrow, abolish (?) (3ms subjunctive, G, s-ʿ-r) (?)
glossary.ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
glossary.ይትቄረብ: ቀረበ — it is offered, brought near (?) (3ms imperfect, tä-stem passive of ቀረበ 'draw near', q-r-b) (?)
glossary.ይትፌሥሕ: ተፈሥሐ — he rejoices (3ms imperfect, tä-stem, f-ś-ḥ)
glossary.ይትፌከር: ተፈከረ — it is explained (?) (3ms imperfect, tä-stem passive of ፈከረ 'explain, interpret', f-k-r) (?)
glossary.ይንግሩ: ነገረ — that they tell, proclaim (3mp subjunctive, G, n-g-r)
glossary.ይንፋሕ: ነፍሐ — that it blow (3ms subjunctive, G, n-f-ḥ; the subject, ነፋሳተ 'winds', stands in the accusative before it)
glossary.ይገብር: ገብረ — he does, makes (3ms imperfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ይጠአጣእ: ይጠአጣእ — unidentified verb, sense unknown (?) (3ms subjunctive of an unrecognised root, perhaps quadriliteral ṭ-ʾ-ṭ-ʾ; no lemma can be given) (?)
glossary.ይፃእ: ወፅአ — that it go out (3ms subjunctive, G, w-ṣ-ʾ; the accusative አንቅዕተ 'springs' is its subject)
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ጸባኦት: ጸባኦት — hosts (noun, plural; እግዚአብሔር ጸባኦት 'God of hosts')
glossary.ጽዕለቶሙ: ጽዕለት — their arrogance, or perhaps 'hostility' (?) (noun + -ሙ '3mp their'; meaning uncertain) (?)
glossary.ጽድቅ: ጽድቅ — righteousness, justice (noun; ፀሐየ ጽድቅ 'sun of righteousness')
glossary.ፈጠራ: ፈጠረ — he created her (3ms perfect, G, f-ṭ-r; + -ኣ 'her')
glossary.፩: ፩ — numeral 1 — chapter number · spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', in ch. 22 'a certain' (ወሀለወ ፩ ልብው 'there was a certain wise man') · 'one' of a number (ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants') · 'one' as a pronoun, 'one … another' (ይነግሮ ፩ ለካልኡ 'one tells another'; ch. 53) · 'anyone' after a negative or ዘእንበለ (ዘእንበለ ያእምር ፩ 'without anyone knowing') · 'one' before ኅሊና (፩ ኅሊና 'one mind, of one mind'), spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu), the masculine, since ኅሊና takes masculine agreement in this part (ባዕደ ኅሊና, በኅሊና ሠናይ)
glossary.፩ውእቱ: ፩ — numeral 1 — spoken አሐዱ (ʾäḥädu) 'one', here written joined to ውእቱ (wəʾətu) 'he, is' (፩ውእቱ = 'one is he'; the wordspace is missing in the source) (numeral + 3ms pronoun/copula)
